module.purpose: Provides combineSlices, a Redux reducer factory that supports lazy injection of slice reducers after initialisation, with type-safe selector proxies for injected state.
module.summary: This module exports a combineSlices function that builds a Redux reducer capable of having slice reducers injected dynamically. It returns an object with inject, withLazyLoadedSlices, and selector methods. The selector uses a Proxy to supply initial state for not-yet-dispatched injected slices, ensuring type safety. Internal helpers detect slice-like objects, build a reducer map, and cache initial states. It integrates with Redux Toolkit's type system for code-splitting scenarios.
module.businessContext: Enables code-splitting and lazy loading of Redux slices in RTK apps. Failure breaks dynamic feature loading or throws on undefined slice state.

detail.name: isSliceLike
detail.signature: const isSliceLike = (maybeSliceLike: AnySliceLike | ReducerMap): maybeSliceLike is AnySliceLike =>
preconditions: maybeSliceLike must be coercible to an object for the `in` operator; calling with null/undefined throws a TypeError before any narrowing occurs.
postconditions: When the function returns true, maybeSliceLike is narrowed to AnySliceLike because a string-typed `reducerPath` property was found.
When the function returns false, the input is treated as a plain ReducerMap (no string `reducerPath`).
invariants: The function is referentially transparent: identical inputs always yield identical boolean results.
A returned true value strictly implies `typeof maybeSliceLike.reducerPath === 'string'`.
edgeCases: null or undefined input: the `in` operator throws a TypeError at runtime, before the typeof check is evaluated.
object without a `reducerPath` property (e.g. a ReducerMap): returns false.
object whose `reducerPath` exists but is non-string (number, undefined, object): returns false.
object whose `reducerPath` is a string (own or inherited): returns true.

raises: TypeError (JavaScript runtime error) when the `in` operator is applied to null or undefined

units.name: getReducers
units.source:
const getReducers = (slices: Array<AnySliceLike | ReducerMap>) =>
  slices.flatMap<[string, Reducer]>((sliceOrMap) =>
    isSliceLike(sliceOrMap)
      ? [[sliceOrMap.reducerPath, sliceOrMap.reducer]]
      : Object.entries(sliceOrMap),
  )

  slices.flatMap<[string, Reducer]>((sliceOrMap) =>

preconditions: slices must be an array (Array.isArray)
each element must conform to AnySliceLike or ReducerMap shape
AnySliceLike elements must expose reducerPath: string and reducer: Reducer fields
ReducerMap elements must be plain objects compatible with Object.entries
postconditions: returns a new flat array of [string, Reducer] tuples
order of entries preserves iteration order from the input array
no mutation of the input slices array or its elements
each AnySliceLike input produces exactly one tuple keyed by its reducerPath
each ReducerMap input contributes one tuple per own enumerable property
invariants: output tuples always pair a string path with a Reducer value
no duplicate path deduplication — all input entries are emitted

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: throws TypeError if a non-object element reaches Object.entries

detail.summary: Normalizes a heterogeneous array of SliceLike objects and ReducerMaps into a flat list of [path, reducer] tuples, used to assemble combined reducer maps.
